decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered out the numerous accessories like cases, straps, and chargers to focus on actual hardware. My consideration set included a high-end audiophile option (Bang & Olufsen), a reliable mid-range classic (JBL Renewed), a high-value budget waterproof speaker (INSMY), a 40W party speaker (Ortizan), and a unique aesthetic choice (Rerii). I ultimately chose the JBL Charge 4 (Renewed) because, at $89.95, it provides the best combination of brand reliability, sound performance, and rugged waterproof features. While the B&O speaker is premium, its high price tag is harder to justify compared to the proven durability and performance of the Charge 4, even in its renewed state.
